intent: Keep the staged package separate from an untouched execution control. The empty control state must be as visible as the package, distinguishing preparation from execution.
source:
**Frame:** The plugin sits beside an execution control that remains untouched. A small status line reads `STAGED`, clearly identified as reconstructed UI.

**Action:** Command-capable material is present but has not yet been confirmed running.

**Screen / system text:**
`PLUGIN — STAGED`

**Provenance:** `documented` + `reconstructed` — download is sourced; status wording protects the chronology.
title: The plugin is staged but not executed
